extensionDescription.message: Scan media posts on X by username and date, preview the results, and download selected images and videos.

copyrightNotice.message: Only download media you own or are authorized to save. Not affiliated with X Corp.

introDescription.message: This extension downloads media files from a specified X user. Sign in to X and open the target user's page; the username will be detected automatically, or you can edit it below.

loginPrompt.message: Sign in to X and open any x.com page first.

invalidDateRange.message: The start date cannot be later than the end date.

scanCouldNotStart.message: The scan could not be started.

scanQueued.message: Scan queued. It will start automatically after the media page loads.

skippedVideosSummary.message: $1 video items were skipped because no downloadable source was available.

summaryNoDate.message: $1 media items · $2 images · $3 videos · no scan time

helperNeeded.message: HLS/DASH detected. Run the optional local helper with FFmpeg before downloading these items.

browserDownloadsAll.message: All items can be downloaded directly by the browser.

helperPermissionDenied.message: Failed: localhost helper permission was not granted

noItemsSelected.message: Select at least one item to download.

allDownloadsCompleted.message: All $1 selected items have finished downloading.

ratePrompt.message: If you are satisfied with the extension, please consider rating it in the Chrome Web Store.

mediaPageOpenFailed.message: The target media page did not open correctly

contentScanStartFailed.message: The page scanner could not be started

loadingMedia.message: Waiting for the media page and complete media list…

endReached.message: Reached the end of the current results.

maxReached.message: Reached the maximum number of posts.
